transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the final check for the 'Tidal Memory' installation in Gallery 4. The current draft proposes online-connected playback, eight visitor stations, 15-minute sessions, and a 5:00 PM public opening on October 12. Before I can approve this plan, I need to hear from each of you — rights, technical, accessibility, and artist representatives — on whether you have any conditions that must be added. Who would like to go first?

transcript.text: I need to flag a technical condition. Yesterday after the installation rehearsal, I completed the headset and network test and found that the approved headset model supports only six simultaneous stations — not eight — and each session is limited to exactly 12 minutes to prevent thermal shutdown. The test report is still in the equipment vendor's queue, so this hasn't been circulated yet. The draft plan's eight stations and 15-minute sessions will need to be revised to six stations and 12-minute sessions before I can sign off on the technical side.

transcript.text: I have an accessibility condition to add. I confirmed today with the festival's access consultant that one of the six stations must be a seated, step-free station, and that every visitor notice must display the exact warning 'Flashing light and sudden sound'. I should note that the consultant's written confirmation came in after the draft visitor signage was already sent to print, so the signage will need to be reprinted with the corrected warning.
